mcp.addFile.messageAdded: Adds {file} to the workspace (.hive/mcp){files, plural, =0 {} one {, with its file in a folder of its own} other {, with its # files in a folder of its own}}, added to no project yet. Add it where it should run: a project’s MCP tab, the Assistant’s view, or Add to… here. It runs:
mcp.addFile.replaceDetailAdded: Replace moves it (and the folder of one added from a .zip) to the Recycle Bin and adds this one to no project yet: projects and the Assistant that had the old one lose it. Or choose another name.
mcp.allProjects.confirmMessage: New sessions in every project start it, except in projects that turned it off in their MCP tab. To use it in one project only, turn it on in that project's MCP tab instead. It runs:
mcp.catalog.badName: Server names may contain letters, numbers, "-" and "_" (max 64 characters). "hive" is reserved.
mcp.catalog.cantRun: This PC doesn't meet a requirement above, so it can't be installed.
mcp.catalog.expired: That download has expired: choose Install or Update again.
mcp.catalog.folder: {name}'s zip doesn't hold a folder named {name}: not installed.
mcp.catalog.gone: {name} isn't in its catalogue any more: refresh the list.
mcp.catalog.installMessageName: Downloaded and checked against its catalogue. It is added to the workspace under this name, and to no project yet. It runs:
mcp.catalog.installedNext: It runs nowhere yet: Add to… in its view adds it to the projects (and the Assistant) that need it.
mcp.catalog.mismatch: {name}'s download doesn't match its catalogue (its size or checksum differ): not installed.
mcp.catalog.none: No catalogues are on. Turn ours on, or add one, in Settings → MCP Catalogues.
mcp.catalog.notInstalled: {name} isn't installed from this catalogue: install it instead.
mcp.catalog.pick: Select a server in the Catalogue to see what it needs and install it.
mcp.catalog.placesChanged: Where {name} is added changed while the update waited: look again.
mcp.catalog.refreshAgain: Refresh (↻) to list this catalogue again: Combwork keeps only so many in memory.

mcp.catalog.sourceUrl: A catalogue is an https:// or file:// address of its catalog.json.
mcp.catalog.tooLarge: {url} is larger than its catalogue says ({max, number} bytes at most): not used.
mcp.catalog.tooManySources: Combwork lists at most {max, number} catalogues of your own: remove one first.
mcp.catalog.unknown: Combwork can't check this: make sure it's there
mcp.catalog.unvetted: Servers from this source aren't checked by Combwork. Look at what one runs before you install it.

mcp.error.noProject: {project} is no longer a project in this workspace.
mcp.error.noServerAdd: The workspace has no MCP server named {name}.
